test_title: PYST 5 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In each question below is given a statement followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the suggested courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

Statement: A large number of cyber fraud cases are being reported where people are losing money through fake banking apps.

Course of action I: Ban all online banking services immediately.

Course of action II: Increase cybersecurity measures and run awareness campaigns for users.
solution:
*]:pointer-events-auto scroll-mt-[calc(var(--header-height)+min(200px,max(70px,20svh)))]" data-scroll-anchor="true" data-testid="conversation-turn-8" data-turn="assistant" data-turn-id="request-WEB:2cb423f0-7d10-49f2-bc0c-e59254b0a8e1-3" dir="auto" tabindex="-1">

Checking the options:

Course of Action I: Ban all online banking services immediately
This step is extreme and impractical. Online banking is an essential service, and banning it would create widespread inconvenience without directly solving the issue of fraudulent apps. Therefore, this does not logically follow.

Course of Action II: Increase cybersecurity measures and run awareness campaigns for users
This step directly targets the problem by strengthening security systems and educating users about fraud prevention. It is practical, preventive, and logically connected to the issue stated. Therefore, this logically follows.

Hence, only Course of Action II follows.
